admission.justification: A future navigation cleanup must not replace the explicit marker return with outside subject selections and accidentally change walk/history semantics.

alternatives.option: Use the review marker’s visible Back operation, not a separate browser-history subject entry.
alternatives.reason: Browser-history selection is an outside selection and can reset the walked tree; the review address deliberately has one history entry.

alternatives.option: Make each followed marker a browser-history selection and use browser Back as its return.
alternatives.reason: Browser-history selection is an outside selection and can reset the walked tree; the review address deliberately has one history entry.
alternatives.reconsider_when: A new approved navigation contract specifies history entries and retained-walk restoration without silently resetting reading state.

consequences: A future navigation cleanup must not replace the explicit marker return with outside subject selections and accidentally change walk/history semantics.
No promise that the current marker return itself preserves every walked family; it restores its owned workspace state.
